title: Tina and the Lantern Shadow
synopsis: A little moth makes an enormous playful shadow beside a softly lit porch and discovers whose shape it is.

related_resources.reason: NASA’s hands-on family activity describes moving a light or object to investigate shadows; not an assessment of this manuscript.
Caregiver guidance discusses pointing out changes and following curiosity.
Reading tips recommend inviting observations and predictions, not requiring a scientific answer.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: The dark wings on the wall grew even larger.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: The changing projected shape connects to light-and-object shadow demonstrations, not to claims about moth learning.
rationale_citations.evidence_scope: Parent/caregiver guidance supports only broad age-appropriate editorial practices. It does not assess this original story or prove any cognitive, behavioral or sleep outcome.
